yaml.title: Briana Maximino | Marketing Portfolio
yaml.description: Marketing portfolio showcasing brand strategy, campaign projects, dashboards, analytics, and presentations.

markdown.markdown:
::: {.hero} ::: {.hero-copy} ## Marketing Strategy • Brand Engagement • Sports Marketing I’m a Business Administration student concentrating in Marketing at Cal Poly Pomona. My portfolio showcases campaign strategy, brand positioning, marketing analytics, and digital storytelling through academic and hands-on projects. [View Projects](projects.qmd){.btn .btn-primary} [View Resume](resume.qmd){.btn .btn-secondary} ::: ::: {.hero-card} ### Portfolio Snapshot **Focus:** Marketing strategy, sports marketing, brand engagement **Tools:** Quarto, R, Excel, Google Analytics, GitHub Pages **Goal:** Build data-informed campaigns that connect brands with the right audience. ::: :::
Professional Focus
Marketing work that connects strategy, storytelling, and data.

My portfolio is designed for employers, professors, and professional connections who want to see how I approach marketing projects from idea to execution. I focus on clear branding, audience understanding, campaign planning, and measurable results.

Featured Areas
What this portfolio highlights

Campaign Strategy

Projects that show how I plan, position, and communicate marketing ideas for a target audience.

View Projects →

Marketing Analytics

Dashboards and analytics pages that show my ability to organize data and explain insights clearly.

View Dashboard →

Presentation Skills

A Revealjs presentation showing my ability to create polished, web-based professional presentations.

View Presentation →
Skills
Marketing + technical skills
Marketing Strategy Brand Positioning Campaign Planning Consumer Insights Sports Marketing Social Media Strategy Market Research R Quarto ggplot2 Excel Google Analytics GitHub Pages
About
A portfolio built for marketing opportunities.

I am interested in how brands use storytelling, data, and customer experience to build stronger connections. My projects reflect both the creative side of marketing and the analytical side needed to evaluate performance.
